execution_environment: ChatGPT Python runtime; CPU; Python 3.13; NumPy; Numba
interpretation: Persistent BP message state resolves 11 of the 16 original packaged-decoder nonconvergence cases.
Message persistence alone does not solve BPGD fidelity: the custom stateful engine produced 12 different failures and 17 total nonconvergences on the fixed-seed corpus.
The remaining mismatch is likely in one or more of the exact sum-product equations, reliability definition, syndrome-sign convention, update ordering, numerical clipping, or tie-breaking behavior.
scientific_boundary: This is a full fixed-seed integration validation, not a successful paper reproduction. Pure-BPGD performance comparisons remain blocked because nonconvergence is not yet eliminated or reconciled with the paper's implementation.
